spades-core.consumer: unicycler (short-read mode is an external SPAdes optimiser)

license.obligations: Distribute corresponding source and GPL-2 notices with any image; bundled ext/ libraries carry their own licenses (samtools MIT, hmmer GPL, bwa GPL, googletest BSD, mimalloc MIT, nlopt LGPL). Do not relabel SPAdes as GPL-3.0.

spades-core.donor_build_path: git clone https://github.com/ablab/spades /opt/spades-src && cd /opt/spades-src && git checkout 896694ce5c7a9050a6ffa9fccc950a4cd9f04363 && cd assembler && PREFIX=/opt/spades ./spades_compile.sh -j2

python2.7.consumer: savage-denovo (HaploConduct haploconduct.py / savage.py are Python 2 scripts)
python2.7.version_attestation: Include/patchlevel.h PY_VERSION == 2.7.18 in both byte-pinned archives

license.obligations: GPL-compatible; retain the PSF license agreement and copyright notice in any distributed image.

scipy_dependency.why: last scipy release whose PyPI requires_python includes 2.7; scipy 1.3.0 requires >=3.5

python2.7.donor_build_path: curl -fsSLO https://www.python.org/ftp/python/2.7.18/Python-2.7.18.tgz && tar xzf Python-2.7.18.tgz && cd Python-2.7.18 && ./configure --prefix=/opt/python27 && make -j2 && make install && cd .. && tar xzf scipy-1.2.3.tar.gz && cd scipy-1.2.3 && /opt/python27/bin/python setup.py install
python2.7.blocker: Prior Dockerfile used apt python2.7/python-scipy, which is not source-attested. Source-built donor binary hash and interpreter version output must come from a guarded donor job after guard deployment.
